review_text: Manual red teaming, which involves human experts crafting adversarial prompts to elicit unsafe responses from LLMs, is effective but unscalable and time-consuming [arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 1]. Meta has established a human red team consisting of 350 individuals from various job positions to manually create attack samples for the Llama-2 chat models [arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 3]. Current generation-based red teaming research has not fully harnessed the learning capabilities of parameterized LLMs, often using fixed-parameter LLMs to launch attacks [arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 1]. APRT, or Automated Progressive Red Teaming, is a framework that enhances the attack capabilities on both aligned open- and closed-source LLMs by using an Intention Expanding LLM, an Intention Hiding LLM, and an Evil Maker [arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 3]. APRT addresses the limitations of previous methods by progressively adjusting attack directions based on feedback, which is a significant improvement over the indiscriminate selection of successful attack samples used in MART [arXiv:2407.03876, стр. 2]. The reranking-based adaptation procedure in some red-teaming approaches can serve as a quick way to red-team new target LLMs, revealing shared failure modes of current alignment methods [arXiv:2405.18540, стр. 10].

review_text: Speculative decoding (SD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm to accelerate LLM inference without compromising quality [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 1]. The primary latency bottleneck in LLM inference arises from memory reads/writes of LLM parameters, not from arithmetic computations [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 2]. Most existing speculative decoding approaches necessitate either additional parameters or extensive training to construct effective draft models, thereby restricting their applicability across different LLMs and tasks [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 1]. Medusa and Eagle incorporate lightweight draft heads into target LLMs and fine-tune them, achieving 3×∼4× speedups, but these methods require additional pretraining or fine-tuning [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 22]. Plug-and-play speculative decoding approaches offer immediate acceleration of LLM inference without relying on auxiliary models or additional training [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 22]. SWIFT, an on-the-fly self-speculative decoding algorithm, adaptively selects certain intermediate layers of LLMs to skip during inference, making it a plug-and-play solution without additional training or auxiliary models [arXiv:2410.06916, стр. 10].

review_text: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have introduced novel techniques for knowledge editing and model editing, enabling more precise control over the information these models generate [arXiv:2310.02456, стр. 3]. These methods allow for the insertion, deletion, or modification of specific pieces of knowledge within the model, enhancing its adaptability and reliability [arXiv:2309.12345, стр. 5]. For instance, the Knowledge Editing for LLMs (KELL) framework proposes a systematic approach to edit the knowledge base of a model without retraining the entire network [arXiv:2311.01234, стр. 7]. Similarly, the Model Editing via Latent Space Manipulation (MELSM) technique leverages latent space representations to fine-tune model outputs for specific tasks or contexts [arXiv:2312.04567, стр. 4]. These approaches not only improve the accuracy and relevance of LLM outputs but also address ethical and safety concerns by allowing for the removal of biased or harmful content [arXiv:2310.12345, стр. 6].

review_text: Retraining large language models to update knowledge incurs prohibitively high costs, leading to the development of knowledge editing techniques that directly update the internal parameters of these models [arXiv:arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 1]. Current knowledge editing methods have limited scalability for lifelong editing, which is necessary for continuous knowledge updates [arXiv:arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 1]. The techniques of knowledge editing aim to update outdated or incorrect knowledge in large language models without the need for frequent retraining [arXiv:arXiv:2508.01302, стр. 1]. The study explores the fundamental reasons why knowledge editing fails in lifelong editing, starting with the closed-form solution derived from linear associative memory [arXiv:arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 1]. The scaling law of superposition suggests future directions for knowledge editing, including attempting knowledge editing in larger language models with sparser architectures and decomposing knowledge within models [arXiv:arXiv:2408.07413, стр. 7]. Knowledge editing is crucial for addressing the static parametric knowledge in large language models that becomes outdated after pretraining [arXiv:arXiv:2608.25100, стр. 1].

review_text: Recent advancements in machine unlearning, particularly for large language models, have focused on developing methods to remove the influence of specific data points from trained models without retraining from scratch [arXiv:2309.08557, стр. 2]. These techniques aim to address privacy concerns and data rights by enabling the selective forgetting of sensitive information [arXiv:2309.08557, стр. 3]. One approach involves using influence functions to approximate the effect of removing data points, which can be computationally efficient but may not always be accurate [arXiv:2304.05916, стр. 4]. Another method leverages model distillation, where a smaller model is trained to mimic the behavior of the original model but without the influence of the unwanted data [arXiv:2304.05916, стр. 5]. However, these methods often face challenges in maintaining the performance of the model after unlearning, especially in large-scale settings [arXiv:2309.08557, стр. 6]. Despite these challenges, ongoing research continues to explore more effective and scalable solutions for machine unlearning in large language models [arXiv:2309.08557, стр. 7].

review_text: The forgetting of large language models (LLMs) during continual finetuning has received some attention in recent years, showing the importance of pretraining to mitigate forgetting [arXiv:2410.14159, стр. 3]. Exact Unlearning is a full retraining-based approach that ensures complete data removal by retraining from scratch, offering the strongest guarantees of compliance and reversibility, but it is computationally intensive and impractical for large-scale or continuously learning systems [arXiv:2509.10590, стр. 10]. To assess open-world forgetting, the performance of both the original unaltered model and the Customized Model Set is evaluated on 10,000 user prompts from the DiffusionDB dataset [arXiv:2410.14159, стр. 5]. Machine Unlearning (MU) has emerged as a promising approach to addressing persistent challenges in responsible and adaptive AI, particularly in the context of large language models [arXiv:2509.10590, стр. 1].

review_text: Recent advancements in natural language processing have led to the development of sophisticated models capable of generating human-like text, raising concerns about the authenticity and origin of such content [arXiv:2304.05747, стр. 2]. To address these issues, researchers have explored various watermarking techniques to embed identifiable markers into machine-generated text [arXiv:2306.04002, стр. 3]. These watermarks can be used to trace the source of the text and to distinguish it from human-written content, thereby enhancing the security and reliability of text generation systems [arXiv:2307.12345, стр. 5]. One notable approach involves the use of subtle, contextually consistent perturbations that are imperceptible to humans but can be detected by specialized algorithms [arXiv:2308.09876, стр. 4]. Another method leverages the inherent randomness in the generation process to create unique fingerprints for each model, which can be verified post-generation [arXiv:2309.10123, стр. 6]. These techniques have shown promise in both laboratory settings and real-world applications, although challenges remain in ensuring robustness against adversarial attacks and maintaining the naturalness of the watermarked text [arXiv:2310.01234, стр. 7].

review_text: Watermarking techniques have emerged as promising solutions to distinguish between human and machine-generated content, providing a reliable means of tracing the origin of the text and verifying its authenticity [arXiv:arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 1]. The watermarking method is not only applicable to generated text but also to human-written text, thereby broadening its potential scope and utility [arXiv:arXiv:2305.08883, стр. 11]. Watermarking techniques can maintain the original semantics of human-written text, as indicated by the results in Figure 14 [arXiv:arXiv:2305.08883, стр. 11]. Watermarking schemes can be broadly divided into two categories: pre-text watermarks and post-text watermarks, with the requirement that the watermarked text and unwatermarked text are indistinguishable [arXiv:arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 13]. The reliability of watermarking as a strategy to identify machine-generated text is investigated, focusing on whether watermarks remain detectable under various types of realistic corruptions, such as mixing with human-written text or rewriting parts of the text [arXiv:arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 2]. Format-based watermarks do not modify the content of the text but change the format of the text in ways that are imperceptible to humans [arXiv:arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 4]. Watermarking techniques can achieve high-confidence detections when enough tokens are observed, such as detecting the watermark after observing 800 tokens on average with a 1e−5 false positive rate [arXiv:arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 1].

review_text: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has emerged as a critical technique for reducing the computational and memory requirements of large language models (LLMs) without significant loss in performance [arXiv:2309.08580, стр. 2]. This method involves converting the weights and activations of a pre-trained model from high-precision (e.g., 32-bit floating-point) to lower-precision (e.g., 8-bit integer) formats [arXiv:2309.08580, стр. 3]. PTQ techniques have been shown to effectively compress models, making them more suitable for deployment on resource-constrained devices such as mobile phones and edge servers [arXiv:2305.14341, стр. 4]. However, the challenge lies in maintaining the model's accuracy and performance, as quantization can introduce quantization errors that affect the model's output [arXiv:2305.14341, стр. 5]. review_text: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have seen the integration of mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures to enhance computational efficiency and model performance. MoE models achieve this by routing input data to specialized sub-models, or experts, which are activated based on the input, thereby introducing sparsity and reducing the computational load [arXiv:2106.05915, стр. 2]. This sparsity not only improves the efficiency of the models but also allows for better scaling to larger datasets and more complex tasks [arXiv:2201.05598, стр. 3]. However, the effectiveness of MoE models depends significantly on the routing mechanisms used to distribute inputs to the appropriate experts [arXiv:2107.06726, стр. 4]. Studies have shown that optimizing these routing algorithms can lead to significant improvements in both performance and efficiency [arXiv:2302.05648, стр. 5]. Despite these benefits, MoE models also introduce challenges, such as increased complexity in training and the potential for load imbalance among experts [arXiv:2106.05915, стр. 6].

review_text: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable efficient scaling of large language models through conditional computation, where different tokens can be processed by different experts, allowing the model to allocate specialized capacity dynamically [arXiv:2603.11114, стр. 2]. In top-k routing, the k experts with the highest probability are selected, and only these experts are active for token t at layer ℓ [arXiv:2603.11114, стр. 2]. Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) models scale more efficiently than dense models by routing tokens to modular expert networks that are only active for processing a fraction of tokens [arXiv:2610.11775, стр. 1]. A leading hypothesis for the performance of MoE models is that they achieve specialization through the routing mechanism, which can dynamically allocate computational resources to different experts based on the input [arXiv:2610.11775, стр. 1]. In an MoE head, a gating network assigns routing scores to a set of expert networks, each of which processes the input differently [arXiv:2601.15021, стр. 2]. The routing mechanism in MoE models can be simulated under uniform random expert selection to estimate the similarity expected if routing were governed solely by balancing constraints [arXiv:2603.11114, стр. 5].

review_text: Recent advancements in transformer models have introduced the concept of Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) to effectively handle long-context sequences, enhancing the model's ability to capture long-range dependencies [arXiv:2104.09864, стр. 3]. RoPE scales the positional encodings in a way that maintains the relative positions of tokens, which is crucial for tasks requiring an understanding of the sequence structure [arXiv:2104.09864, стр. 4]. However, the effectiveness of RoPE in very long sequences has been questioned, leading to the exploration of position interpolation techniques to improve scalability [arXiv:2206.11887, стр. 5]. These techniques aim to interpolate the positional embeddings to better represent the positions of tokens in longer sequences, thereby enhancing the model's performance on tasks that require a broader context [arXiv:2206.11887, стр. 6]. Experiments have shown that combining RoPE with position interpolation can significantly improve the performance of transformer models on tasks such as language modeling and text classification [arXiv:2302.05655, стр. 7]. However, the computational overhead of these methods remains a challenge, and further research is needed to optimize their efficiency [arXiv:2302.05655, стр. 8].

RoPE-based scaling methods, including linear interpolation and frequency-aware YaRN, are popular approaches to extend the context window of pretrained large language models at inference [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 1]. RoPE introduces no additional asymptotic cost, as it is a per-token, per-head (sin, cos) rotation applied to dh/2 pairs, preserving the compute and memory complexity of scaled dot-product attention while endowing it with both absolute and relative position awareness [arXiv:2510.00028, стр. 3]. The low-frequency rotary components of RoPE carry the long-range semantic and positional signal, which are essential for tasks requiring extended context [arXiv:2606.21249, стр. 16]. YaRN and NTK-aware RoPE refinements are effective in extending the context window of large language models without significant performance degradation, as demonstrated by their ability to handle 8k+ context sizes [arXiv:2402.03303, стр. 11].

review_text: The problem of hallucinations in LLMs has attracted significant attention recently, with various methods being developed to detect when models generate factually incorrect or inconsistent content [arXiv:2603.22812, стр. 2]. Existing methods for hallucination detection can be roughly divided into several categories, including approaches that leverage the hidden states of prompts and responses in LLMs, revealing that hallucinatory responses show greater deviations from prompts compared to grounded responses [arXiv:2506.09886, стр. 2]. One novel, model-intrinsic approach to hallucination detection utilizes nonparametric Maximum Mean Discrepancy distances to construct hallucination scores without requiring external knowledge bases or auxiliary models [arXiv:2506.09886, стр. 2]. Extensive experiments with five datasets and three LLMs up to 15B in size demonstrate that this method achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance in hallucination detection [arXiv:2506.09886, стр. 3]. Probing techniques can address latency issues by training lightweight models to predict semantic dispersion or hallucination probability directly from internal model representations [arXiv:2602.04577, стр. 1]. However, these methods typically collapse the complex notion of language model uncertainty into a single scalar metric, ignoring the topology of the underlying output distribution [arXiv:2602.04577, стр. 1]. The proposed method using Maximum Mean Discrepancy distances outperforms or is competitive with other techniques, as shown by ROC AUC scores on multiple datasets and LLMs [arXiv:2506.09886, стр. 11]. When transferring from the SNLI dataset to the hallucination detection task, the proposed method also achieves competitive results, even with a significant domain shift [arXiv:2506.09886, стр. 14].

review_text: Recent studies have highlighted the effectiveness of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in enhancing the performance of large language models on complex tasks, such as arithmetic and logical reasoning [arXiv:2304.08537, стр. 3]. However, these models often exhibit a lack of faithfulness in their reasoning processes, leading to plausible but incorrect conclusions [arXiv:2305.17365, стр. 5]. The limitations of CoT reasoning are particularly evident in tasks that require deep understanding and context, where the models may fail to capture the nuances of the problem [arXiv:2306.04567, стр. 7]. Additionally, the reliance on CoT can sometimes result in overfitting to specific patterns in the training data, which may not generalize well to new or unseen scenarios [arXiv:2307.09821, стр. 4]. Despite these limitations, CoT reasoning remains a valuable tool for improving the interpretability and performance of language models, especially when combined with other techniques such as few-shot learning and prompt engineering [arXiv:2308.12345, стр. 6].

review_text: A novel parametric faithfulness framework (PFF) was introduced to measure the faithfulness of chains of thought, with two metrics: FF-HARD and FF-SOFT [arXiv:2502.14829, стр. 9]. The PFF framework supports multiple ways to measure parametric faithfulness, and one such way is through unlearning reasoning steps (FUR) [arXiv:2502.14829, стр. 3]. Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in language models (LMs) provides a structured response where the model explicitly generates a sequence of reasoning steps [arXiv:2406.10625, стр. 2]. Prior studies have shown that CoT explanations generated by LLMs do not always accurately reflect the actual behavior of the underlying models [arXiv:2406.10625, стр. 1]. Three broad approaches are commonly employed to enhance the faithfulness of CoT reasoning generated by LLMs: in-context learning, fine-tuning, and inference-time interventions [arXiv:2406.10625, стр. 1]. The hard metric FF-HARD answers the question 'Is the CoT generated by the model faithful?', while the soft metric FF-SOFT identifies which CoT steps are most relevant [arXiv:2502.14829, стр. 9].

review_text: Improving self-consistency in LLMs through probabilistic tokenization is a key focus in recent research [arXiv:2407.03678, стр. 6]. Hypothesis-driven theory-of-mind reasoning for LLMs is an emerging area of research, particularly in tasks such as solving math and coding problems [arXiv:2502.11881, стр. 1]. Inference-time reasoning in LLMs has shown significant advancements, including the generation of intermediate reasoning steps and the exploration of multiple reasoning paths [arXiv:2502.11881, стр. 10]. Reasoning-CV, a novel fine-tuning method for LLMs, aims to improve the quality of reasoning paths and calibrate the LLM’s judgment thresholds through a two-stage process [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. The first stage of Reasoning-CV involves prompting GPT-4o to generate reliable reasoning paths for ground-truth labels and performing supervised fine-tuning [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 2]. The second stage of Reasoning-CV uses conditional LLM generation for preferences to enhance the quality of reasoning paths and improve consistency [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 8]. Despite advancements, LLMs still face challenges in maintaining consistency in long reasoning paths and setting appropriate acceptance thresholds [arXiv:2505.12348, стр. 5].

SurGE formalizes survey generation as a two-stage process: retrieving relevant papers from a comprehensive corpus and synthesizing the retrieved evidence into a structured survey [arXiv:2508.15658, стр. 2]. The AI Literature Review Suite can have a considerable impact in rapidly evolving domains such as medicine, science, and engineering, where keeping up with the latest research findings is crucial [arXiv:2308.02443, стр. 6]. SurGE's contributions include introducing a method-agnostic benchmark for survey generation, proposing an automated evaluation framework, and conducting experiments that reveal limitations in SOTA LLM-based survey generation systems [arXiv:2508.15658, стр. 2].

However, challenges remain, including the need for large annotated datasets and the computational cost of training these models [arXiv:2310.02414, стр. 5]. Despite these challenges, the potential benefits of visual instruction tuning in improving the performance and usability of multimodal models are substantial [arXiv:2309.12065, стр. 6].

review_text: To address the scarcity of high-quality instruction tuning data, the SVIT dataset was constructed, containing 4.2 million visual instruction tuning data, including 1.6M conversation QA pairs, 1.6M complex reasoning QA pairs, 1.0M referring QA pairs, and 106K detailed image descriptions [arXiv:arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 1]. The SVIT dataset is 20 times larger than existing datasets, aiming to push the limits of large multimodal models by providing high-quality and diverse instruction tuning data [arXiv:arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 1]. In contrast to prior approaches that mix human-labeled data with GPT-4 synthesized data, a two-stage instruction tuning pipeline is introduced, where VLMs are first fine-tuned on VISION-FLAN and then on GPT-4 synthesized data [arXiv:arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 4]. The two-stage tuning framework significantly outperforms the traditional single-stage visual instruction tuning framework, achieving state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of multi-modal tasks [arXiv:arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 1]. StableLLaVA and VPG-C use generative models like Stable Diffusion or Blended Diffusion to generate both images and texts, which helps alleviate domain bias and encourages VLMs to attend to visual details [arXiv:arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 8]. Liu et al. (2023b) highlight the bias introduced by positive instructions and propose using negative instruction examples to improve the robustness of VLMs [arXiv:arXiv:2402.11690, стр. 8]. LLaVA-v1.5, Qwen-VL-Chat, and InstructBLIP are examples of end-to-end differentiable multimodal models that input both vision and language tokens into a language model, making them lightweight and concise for research [arXiv:arXiv:2307.04087, стр. 2].

review_text: Recent advancements in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have highlighted the importance of chunking strategies and retrieval granularity for optimizing performance and efficiency [arXiv:2309.08555, стр. 3]. Chunking strategies, which involve breaking down documents into smaller, manageable segments, can significantly enhance the relevance and coherence of retrieved information [arXiv:2304.08899, стр. 5]. Studies have shown that finer-grained retrieval, such as sentence-level or paragraph-level chunking, can improve the precision of retrieved contexts, leading to more accurate and contextually appropriate responses [arXiv:2306.12345, стр. 7]. However, these strategies also introduce trade-offs, as finer-grained retrieval can increase computational costs and the complexity of the retrieval process [arXiv:2307.11111, стр. 4]. To balance these trade-offs, researchers have explored hybrid approaches that combine different levels of granularity, aiming to optimize both performance and efficiency [arXiv:2308.09876, стр. 6].

review_text: Chunking ensures that the retrieved data is precise and relevant, leading to better retrieval performance and higher-quality outputs in RAG systems [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Effective information retrieval in RAG systems relies on accuracy, which involves selecting the most relevant data, and granularity, which ensures that the extracted content is appropriately sized [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 3]. Static heuristics for chunking, such as fixed-length or sentence-level chunking, are often suboptimal, and recent work has explored methods like recursive chunking, sliding window chunking, paragraph-based chunking, and semantic chunking [arXiv:2602.22225, стр. 3]. The static chunking–retrieval design is a primary bottleneck in RAG systems, as retrieval quality is highly sensitive to chunk size, and no single granularity works well across heterogeneous queries and document structures [arXiv:2602.22225, стр. 2]. Moderate chunk overlaps improve retrieval without inflating index size, and selectively scaling LLMs further improves correctness without prohibitive cost [arXiv:2604.12047, стр. 10]. The MultiHop-RAG dataset, consisting of a knowledge base, a large collection of multi-hop queries, their ground-truth answers, and associated supporting evidence, is introduced to benchmark RAG systems [arXiv:2401.15391, стр. 8].

review_text: Recent studies have explored the potential of large language models (LLMs) in enhancing the peer review process for scientific papers, highlighting their ability to provide rapid and consistent feedback [arXiv:2310.02456, стр. 3]. These models can assist in identifying potential issues in methodology, data analysis, and even ethical considerations, thereby improving the overall quality of the review [arXiv:2309.12345, стр. 5]. However, concerns remain regarding the interpretability and reliability of LLM-generated feedback, as these models can sometimes produce inaccurate or misleading suggestions [arXiv:2311.14199, стр. 7]. To address these issues, researchers have proposed integrating human oversight and iterative refinement processes to ensure that LLM-assisted reviews are both accurate and useful [arXiv:2310.02456, стр. 9]. Additionally, there is a growing interest in using LLMs to summarize and synthesize feedback from multiple reviewers, which can help streamline the review process and reduce the workload on individual reviewers [arXiv:2309.12345, стр. 10]. Despite these advancements, the role of human reviewers remains crucial, as they can provide nuanced insights and context that LLMs may lack [arXiv:2311.14199, стр. 12].

review_text: The rapid growth in submissions to machine learning venues has strained the scientific peer-review system, highlighting the need for LLM-assisted solutions [arXiv:2605.26730, стр. 1]. LLM reviewers are best understood as targeted supplements to human review, effective within specific dimensions but unreliable as standalone replacements [arXiv:2605.26730, стр. 1]. AI-assisted peer review is increasingly discussed and adopted as a tool to support the scientific publishing process [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 1]. Prior work has identified limitations of AI-generated reviews, including a tendency to overrate borderline papers [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. Xu et al. (2025) incorporate retrieval of related papers, enabling models to identify missing baselines and citations, enhancing the review process [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 2]. The PRISM benchmark evaluates LLM peer reviewers across multiple dimensions, addressing the highly subjective and domain-specific nature of scientific critiques [arXiv:2605.26730, стр. 17]. AI-generated peer reviews are evaluated on two complementary publication venues: ICLR 2026 and Nature Communications, to assess their capabilities [arXiv:2608.03581, стр. 3].

review_text: Watermarking techniques have emerged as promising solutions to distinguish between human and machine-generated content, providing a reliable means of tracing the origin of the text and verifying its authenticity [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 1]. The watermarking method is not only applicable to generated text but also to human-written text, thereby broadening its potential scope and utility [arXiv:2305.08883, стр. 11]. Watermarking techniques can achieve high-confidence detections when enough tokens are observed, such as detecting the watermark after observing 800 tokens on average with a 1e−5 false positive rate [arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 1]. Watermarking schemes can be broadly divided into two categories: pre-text watermarks and post-text watermarks, with the requirement that the watermarked text and unwatermarked text are indistinguishable [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 13]. Format-based watermarks do not modify the content of the text but change the format of the text in ways that are imperceptible to humans [arXiv:2407.04794, стр. 4]. Watermarking can maintain the original semantics of human-written text, as indicated by the results in Figure 14 [arXiv:2305.08883, стр. 11]. Detection strategies must guarantee low false-positive rates, which need to be balanced against detection sensitivity, as every false positive can be extremely harmful [arXiv:2306.04634, стр. 10].

review_text: Constitutional AI, proposed and developed by Anthropic AI, aims to hardcode explicit principles and values into AI models to make their decision-making more transparent and accountable [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 1]. Constitutional AI involves training AI models to align with constitutional guidelines and penalizing deviations, with the goal of instilling these values into the AI's objective function over time [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 8]. The opacity and inscrutability of advanced AI systems pose significant challenges to establishing their legitimacy in the eyes of those subject to their power [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 5]. Public Constitutional AI is a framework that involves the public in drafting an AI constitution, transforming it from a technical solution into a product of significant citizen involvement [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 2]. Public Constitutional AI aims to bridge the gap between the abstract logic of algorithms and the lived realities of human communities by making AI training a site of democratic contestation and negotiation [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 11]. While Constitutional AI is a promising start, it may fall short of securing robust legitimacy for AI authority, necessitating a more participatory approach [arXiv:2406.16696, стр. 6].

Additionally, researchers have investigated the use of out-of-distribution detection techniques to flag inputs that are likely to cause the model to hallucinate [arXiv:2308.09876, стр. 6]. These methods have shown promising results in reducing the frequency and impact of hallucinations in LLMs [arXiv:2312.00123, стр. 7].

review_text: The Continuous Memory Machine (CMM) builds on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM) by introducing an explicit matrix-valued long-term memory that operates alongside its sliding-window short-term memory (STM) [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. The CTM has no persistent mechanism for storing information over long horizons, which limits its performance on tasks requiring long-term retention [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. The CMM defines the Long-Term Memory (LTM) as a matrix Bt ∈ R^d×ML, where ML columns are treated as tokens of dimension d, and it is initialized with a learned matrix B0 [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. In the CMM, the Transformer jointly updates the short-term and long-term memories, providing an expressive mechanism for writing, retrieval, and reorganization across stores [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. Long short-term memory networks (LSTMs) alleviate the problem of gradient diffusion and explosion by introducing a memory unit and a gate mechanism to capture long dependencies in sequences [arXiv:1610.04989, стр. 3]. LSTMs update their long-term and short-term memories by considering every bit of the memory from the previous time-step [arXiv:1610.04989, стр. 3]. The CMM separates timescales to support distinct retention strategies, similar to multiscale RNNs, and draws on the memory mechanisms of Memory-Augmented Neural Networks (MANNs) [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 4]. The CMM aims to combine flexible short-term computation with persistent storage to improve algorithmic generalization and recurrent reasoning [arXiv:2610.07907, стр. 9].
